name: Plant Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official available requirements and 2027–28 deadlines. Funding amounts are qualified by the period explicitly published; confirm offer-specific terms.

documents: Academic transcripts from every college-level institution

english.toefl: 80 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 for tests on/after that date
english.note: Two-year scores; no MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. DET only when other exams unavailable; DET-only admits take TOEP. English-only US degree or foreign degree with sole English instruction recorded in WHED may exempt; other documentation not accepted. Programs/TA employment may set higher standards.

applicationFee.note: US applicants$135. Central waiver limited to listed graduate-preparation programs, not general financial need. Identify program/coordinator in application; participation verified. International applicants should confirm category eligibility.

requirements.note: Biological-sciences bachelor equivalent, GPA 3. Recommended biology, chemistry, physics, calculus, statistics, genetics and plant coursework; limited deficiencies can be completed after admission. Three recommendations, ideally scientists/research mentors. Opportunity to rotate through four labs in first year.

deadlines.label: General and fellowship
deadlines.note: Current 2027–28 central table; follow earlier department closing rules.

funding.note: Incoming rotation students offered two-quarter fellowship covering tuition, fees and stipend at annual compensation-plan rate. Later GSR/TA, competitive fellowships and external funding; separate departmental TA applications. No multi-year universal guarantee or stipend amount stated.
